top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises one statable concept: a pH-switchable ionizable lipid is near-neutral in circulation and cationic in the endosome, where it favours a non-bilayer membrane-destabilising phase, and controlled mixing co-assembles lipid and nucleic acid into small, efficiently loaded particles. This is lipid polymorphism and self-assembly used as design, independently validated in approved siRNA and mRNA products, and the carrier chemistry was not covered by the 2023 Medicine prize. The Cullis-Hope-Madden allocation rests on concept priority for the pKa principle and encapsulation, though it excludes Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan. P001 (Car-Parrinello) is a very close second with cleaner two-person credit and four decades of use; P003 is mature and well attributed but follows the 2010 cross-coupling prize; no award ranks last because several slate proposals are mature, creditable achievements.
recusal_note: No direct conflict apparent from profile; my research field (lipid self-assembly and membranes) is close to the P002 subject matter, and I sit on the committee with Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai, but I have no stated connection to any proposed laureate.
